scope: Public source and dossier plus post-CI attestations; no raw private/third-party acquisition/credentials/mutable databases. Engine bytes match tested commit; release-upload verification follows in repository.

commands.stdout:
usage: __main__.py [-h]
                   {ingest,analyze,investigate,evaluate,search,query,serve,case,hunt,forensics,decode,live,network,readiness}
                   ...

Offline Windows SOC investigation lab; findings require analyst review.

positional arguments:
  {ingest,analyze,investigate,evaluate,search,query,serve,case,hunt,forensics,decode,live,network,readiness}
    ingest              Atomically import a JSONL evidence file
    analyze             Export timeline, findings and a draft analyst report
    investigate         Build a source-scoped process graph and explainable
                        investigation chains
    evaluate            Evaluate scenario-level review labels on the synthetic
                        development/holdout corpus
    search              Search original events, not only alert matches
    query               Execute a checked-in SQLite investigation query (read-
                        only)
    serve               Open the local, read-only case explorer
    case                Manage analyst decisions separately from source
                        evidence
    hunt                Execute eight fixed read-only investigation hypotheses
    forensics           Reconstruct complete PowerShell 4104 blocks without
                        executing them
    decode              Decode a supported PowerShell encoded host argument as
                        text
    live                Operate the durable single-host collection and alert
                        pilot
    network             Inspect bounded offline IPv4 PCAP evidence and
                        response readiness
    readiness           Đánh giá tài sản, chất lượng telemetry và bàn giao
                        điều tra bằng snapshot chỉ đọc

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
Verified 124 published evidence files, including inventory completeness.
